title: 第6章 天生双系（下）
slug: 全职法师全本免费-全职法师最新章节列表
content_zh:
莫凡一阵欣喜！！！
这个星尘对魔法师来说太重要了，他就是衡量魔法师修为的重要依据，它存在魔法师精神天地中，占据虚无的空间越庞大就说明该魔法师的修为越高！
这个星尘内，莫凡已经可以看到有什么东西被点亮，那好像是一小片紫色的星尘，相对于整个精神世界来说这星尘确实微小如尘，但这同时也意味着自己觉醒没有失败，书上清清楚楚的写着精神世界里拥有了星尘，哪怕再微弱再微弱，就TM觉醒成功了！！
哈哈哈哈，谁说老子会觉醒失败的！
老子这不是觉醒成功了吗？
真想马上看看赵坤三和穆白那扭曲的脸。
等等，星尘是什么颜色。
不是红色，好可惜，没觉醒的是火系啊。
红色星尘，代表着的是火系。
青色星尘，代表着的是风系。
褐色星尘，代表着的是土系。
蓝色星尘，代表着的是水系。
金色星尘，代表着的是光系。
紫色星尘，代表着……
我了个草！！！
突然，莫凡整个人都呆住了！！
紫色！！
自己是紫色星尘，自己居然是紫色星尘！！！
“我的天啊，隔壁班有人觉醒了雷系！”
操场上，突然听见有学生惊呼大喊道。

“什么什么，出现雷系了？？我去，几辈子修来的好运啊。”
“在哪里，在哪里，哇塞，好炫酷的紫色，7班的班主任估计都吓了一大跳吧。”
“呜呜呜，杀了我吧，为什么我是水系，为什么没给我雷系，你们谁都别拦我，我要去天台。”
“别闹，你跳不死的，下面铺了一片光系的尸体。”
“这雷系学生是要完爆全场的节奏啊！”
雷系一出，简直全场轰动！
要说火系是所有平民魔法师们第一觉醒首选的话，那么雷系简直就是上天恩赐的完美第一系，比火系更加霸道的雷之力让魔法师在初阶的时候就拥有以一敌多的恐怖战斗力，有老师们统计过，觉醒了雷系的学生除非是自己荒废不学，其中有五成以上都突破成为了中阶法师！
魔法中考，直接淘汰了大概有6成的魔法学生，让剩下4成的学生成为了觉醒学生。
这群觉醒学生中恐怕还有6成的要被淘汰，因为他们三年魔法高中生涯恐怕任何一个魔法都施放不出来。
全校这一千五百名新生中，唯有1名学生觉醒雷霆系，就足以表明这雷霆系有多么震惊骇俗了！！
一时间，全校师生的目光齐刷刷的朝着高一7班的那个男生飞去，那名男生很恰巧穿的也是紫色的衣服，这让他觉醒起来的那一道道若有若无的紫色雷弧更加出彩夺目，一时间这名显得自信傲冷的男子成为上千人的焦点，引起了全校的沸腾！！
“咦，怎么这么吵？”莫凡缓缓的睁开了眼睛，脸上的欣喜全部写在脸上了。
不过，他入迷了。
莫凡一回头，发现自己身后得所有同学都在看隔壁班。
什么情况？？
你们都在看哪里？？？
很快，莫凡终于发现什么问题了。
原来隔壁班出现了一个雷霆系的，而就在自己觉醒的这瞬间，全校师生的目光齐刷刷的注视着那个比自己快你们一步觉醒的家伙！
莫凡一脸苦逼的看着觉醒石上同样跳跃着的紫色雷弧，真希望一巴掌拍在自己班主任的脸上告诉他，你羡慕隔壁班个毛啊，老子也是狂拽酷炫叼炸天的雷系！！
莫凡刚要说话，突然应该结束了的觉醒石再一次出现了星辰光辉，宛如血脉一样朝着莫凡的手掌上聚集过去。

莫凡满脸惊奇！
觉醒不是结束了吗，怎么这个觉醒石又启动了一次？
莫凡想要把手抽出来，可是那股魔力已经顺着自己手掌传递到了全身。
一股火热的能量！
莫凡都不知道发生了什么事，但一股力量驱使着他再一次进入到精神世界之中，感知着这第二股力量的入侵。
虚无的精神世界里，紫色的星尘仍旧在它自己的那片区域里闪耀着微弱的光辉，看上去很渴望人去让它们更加耀眼更加绽放。
这是莫凡的雷霆系星尘，前不久觉醒的力量。
可另一股觉醒之力如同之前的雷系一样闯入，在莫凡的精神世界里划过了一道触目惊心的火焰弧线，那看上去宛如焚烧的流星，让莫凡整个人都颤动了！
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢全职法师请大家
content_en:
Mo Fan was overjoyed! ! !
This stardust is so important to a magician. It is an important basis for measuring a magician's cultivation level. It exists in the magician's spiritual world. The larger the void space it occupies, the higher the magician's cultivation level is!
Within this stardust, Mo Fan could already see something lit up. It seemed to be a small piece of purple stardust. Compared to the entire spiritual world, this stardust was indeed as tiny as dust, but it also meant that his awakening had not failed. The book clearly stated that if there is stardust in the spiritual world, no matter how weak it is, the awakening is successful! !
Hahahaha, who said I would fail in awakening!
Didn’t I successfully awaken?
I really want to see the twisted faces of Zhao Kunsan and Mu Bai right away.
Wait, what color is stardust?
It's not red, what a pity, it's the fire element that hasn't been awakened.
The red stardust represents the fire element.
The cyan stardust represents the wind element.
Brown stardust represents the earth element.
Blue stardust represents the water system.
Golden stardust represents the light system.
Purple stardust represents...
I'm confused! ! !
Suddenly, Mo Fan was stunned! !
Purple! !
I am purple stardust, I am actually purple stardust! ! !
"Oh my god, someone in the next class has awakened the thunder element!"
On the playground, I suddenly heard some students shouting in surprise.
"What, what, the lightning element appears?? I'll go, you've got good luck after several lifetimes of cultivation."
"Where is it? Where is it? Wow, it's such a cool purple color. The class teacher in Class 7 must have been shocked."
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu""Kill me, why am I a water element? Why didn't you give me the thunder element? Don't stop me, I'm going to the rooftop."
"Don't make trouble, you can't jump to death, there are a lot of light-type corpses underneath."
"This thunder student is going to blow up the entire audience!"
As soon as the thunder element came out, the whole audience was shocked!
If the fire element is the first choice for all civilian magicians to awaken, then the thunder element is simply the perfect first element given by God. The power of thunder, which is more domineering than the fire element, allows magicians to have terrifying combat power of one enemy at the beginning. Some teachers have calculated that unless students who awaken the thunder element neglect to learn, more than 50% of them will break through and become intermediate mages!
The magic high school entrance examination directly eliminated about 60% of magic students, leaving the remaining 40% as awakened students.
I am afraid that 60% of this group of awakened students will be eliminated, because they may not be able to cast any magic in their three-year magic high school career.
Among the fifteen hundred freshmen in the school, only one student has awakened the Thunder Element, which is enough to show how shocking this Thunder Element is! !
For a moment, the eyes of all the teachers and students in the school flew towards the boy in Class 7, Grade 1. That boy happened to be wearing purple clothes, which made the faint purple lightning arcs he awakened even more eye-catching. For a time, this confident and arrogant man became the focus of thousands of people, causing the whole school to be excited! !
"Hey, why is it so noisy?" Mo Fan slowly opened his eyes, the joy on his face was all written on his face.
However, he was fascinated.
When Mo Fan turned around, he found that all the students behind him were looking at the class next door.
What's going on? ?
Where are you looking? ? ?
Soon, Mo Fan finally discovered something was wrong.
It turns out that a thunder type appeared in the next class, and at the moment when he awakened, the eyes of all the teachers and students in the school were fixed on the guy who awakened one step ahead of you!
Mo Fan looked at the purple lightning arc jumping on the Awakening Stone with a bitter look on his face. He really wished he could slap his class teacher on the face and tell him that you envy the guy in the class next door. I also have a cool thunder element that can blast the sky! !
Mo Fan was about to speak when suddenlyThe Awakening Stone, which should have ended, once again glowed with starlight, gathering towards Mo Fan's palm like blood.
Mo Fan’s face was full of surprise!
Isn’t the awakening over? Why is this awakening stone activated again?
Mo Fan wanted to take his hand out, but the magic power had already spread all over his body along his palm.
A fiery energy!
Mo Fan didn't know what happened, but a force drove him to enter the spiritual world again, sensing the invasion of this second force.
In the nihilistic spiritual world, the purple stardust still shines faintly in its own area, seemingly eager for people to make them shine more brightly and bloom.
This is Mo Fan's thunder star dust, the power that was awakened not long ago.
But another awakening force broke in like the previous thunder element, and drew a shocking arc of flames in Mo Fan's spiritual world. It looked like a burning meteor, making Mo Fan's whole body tremble!
